mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log ( log_id, company_id, type, success, employee_uuid, employee_name, message, ip_address, request_id, payload ) VALUES ( #{log.logId}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{log.type}, #{log.success, typeHandler=erp.global.mybatis.BooleanYnTypeHandler}, #{log.employeeUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.employeeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.message}, #{log.ipAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.requestId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.payloadJson, jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.select:
SELECT log_id AS logId, TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, employee_name AS employeeName, type AS type, success AS success, message AS message, ip_address AS ipAddress FROM log
ORDER BY created_at DESC, log_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND success = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todaySuccessCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND success = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayFailCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND type = 'LOGIN' AND success = 'Y' THEN employee_uuid END) AS todayLoginUserCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'WORK' AND created_at >= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '1' HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recentWorkCount FROM log WHERE type != 'ACCESS' AND AND created_at >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 1
